description: Source file implementing the Git::Diff class, which provides methods for computing and retrieving diffs between git commits and files, including handling of diff hunks and file changes.

classes.name: Diff
classes.description: Class providing functionalities to compute and analyze diffs between git commits and files.

methods.name: Diff::Diff (constructor)
methods.description: Initializes a Diff object with a repository key or commits, verifying repository validity.

methods.name: Diff::getAllDifferentFiles
methods.description: Returns a list of all files that differ between commits or the working directory.

methods.name: Diff::getAllHunksForFile
methods.description: Returns all diff hunks for a specified file.

methods.name: Diff::compareRepositories
methods.description: Checks if two commits belong to the same repository.

methods.name: Diff::runDiffCallbacks
methods.description: Executes diff callbacks for files, hunks, and lines based on the current diff.

methods.name: Diff::getLineCallback
methods.description: Returns a callback function for processing diff lines.

methods.name: Diff::getHunkCallback
methods.description: Returns a callback function for processing diff hunks.

methods.name: Diff::getGetFilesCallback
methods.description: Returns a callback function for processing file diffs.

methods.name: Diff::getLibGitDiff (overloaded)
methods.description: Creates a libgit2 diff object between commits or between a commit and the working directory.
